cmd:
( trap '' HUP INT
T=/etc/init.d/.S99zpulsar.tmp
cp /data/pulsar/S99zpulsar.new $T && chmod 755 $T && set -- $(sha256sum $T) && [ "$1" = abc123 ] && mv $T /etc/init.d/S99zpulsar && sync
rc=$?
rm -f $T
exit $rc )

( trap '' HUP INT
mount -o remount,rw / || { echo remount-rw-failed; exit 1; }
T=/etc/init.d/.S99zpulsar.tmp
cp /data/pulsar/S99zpulsar.new $T && chmod 755 $T && set -- $(sha256sum $T) && [ "$1" = abc123 ] && mv $T /etc/init.d/S99zpulsar && sync
rc=$?
rm -f $T
mount -o remount,ro / || rc=1
exit $rc )
